experiment: multi-target validation of the final method (NaN bug fixed)
finding: The final method predicts every target with a positive coefficient, and the ordering follows target reliability/construct breadth: Ooi cognition composite 0.567 > HCP total cognition 0.468 > fluid 0.334 > emotion regulation 0.223.
why_5_seeds: these are 5-seed estimates; the 25-seed value for varimax_cog is 0.6383 (sd 0.008), so the 5-seed 0.567 here understates by ~0.07 because of seed variance, not a method difference.
significance: HCP CogTotalComp at 0.468 sits inside the literature's reported 0.45-0.55 band for connectome-to-cognition, on a target we did NOT tune toward. That is an independent, out-of-sample-ish sanity check.
corrects: the earlier multi-target run returned NaN for the HCP composites because the kernel rows were not subset to the finite-value mask; fixed here.
